name: Makiri Kagetora
source:
Specialty: Western Arts
Hobby: Appreciating Theatre
Likes: Beautiful Things
Dislikes: Disorder

A vagrant painter who has wandered over the entire empire. As he follows alongside the cherry blossom fronts while he heads north, he paints the scenery of every location. He's an oddball who appreciates the beauty in things from all times and places without distinction, and he may or may not have had a certain degree of fame in fellow art circles. 

It seems like he has a deep connection with the girl known as Ren.

[i]"To me, it feels like a door that connects to art I have yet to see…"[i]
